Paper Name: Solar, Wind, Hydrogen, and Bioenergy-Based Hybrid System for Off-Grid Remote Locations: Techno-Economic and Environmental Analysis (Yasmin et al., 2025)
NOTES: System D (PV/BESS/WT/FC/BDG) used as optimal system. All costs in AUD (1 AUD = 0.7 USD). Paper reports COE (0.183 AUD/kWh) not LCOE. LPSP not reported; capacity shortage (0.095%) and unmet electric load (0.045%) reported instead. Hydrogen tank capacity 1000 kg storing 33,333 kWh. BDG fuel intercept (0.028 L/h/kW) and slope (0.253 L/h/kW) reported for biodiesel, not diesel. Converter efficiency 95% for both AC/DC conversion. PV derating factor 88% reported instead of efficiency. Grid not applicable (off-grid). Electrolyzer and FC sizes (kW) are for System D optimal configuration. Battery is Li-ion 100 kWh/unit with 20% min SoC; 4 batteries total (400 kWh, 320 kWh usable).
